display_title: The Male Lead Is Trying To Tame Me With Money
description:
Reborn as the doomed heroine of a tragic novel, she is determined to avoid the male lead and live a quiet life. But when her family goes bankrupt, she’s forced to work as his aide.

Cold and demanding unlike his original self, he keeps her tied to him with money and even a contract engagement. Now trapped in the very story she tried to escape, all she wants is to break free.
